items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: He had a little son. Was in my wife's room. My wife teaches public school.

ctx.x: Well, Dwight Newman. Good piano. Great piano. Pianist. And he had the job at the Music Box. He had a little son. Was in my wife's room. My wife teaches public school. Joseph. Joseph. You talking about the trumpet player. You know, you ain't play high side on the trumpet. Just like you played on the clarinet. He could play it on trumpet like that. He was a good little player. And he was no bigger than that. Oh, he was good. He was good. He was good. He's gone, I bet. Yeah, oh, he's in New York. He's in New York.…
Yeah, oh, he's in New York. He's in New York.
